episodes.synopsis: Shun Asanaga, a young man with an obsession with crystals, finds himself pulled into a world within one.
episodes.title: Ride

episodes.synopsis: After escaping the castle, an encounter with an old friend helps reveal some of the mysteries surrounding Endora.
episodes.title: Endora

episodes.synopsis: Shun and Emilio escape to a hideout but soon abandon it to begin their journey to defeat Delzaine.
episodes.title: Journey

episodes.synopsis: When they're ambushed by a band of revolutionaries, Shun and Emilio make surprising new allies.
episodes.title: Ignauts

episodes.synopsis: Lacking in numbers to revolt, the Ignauts consider an alliance with the very group that attacks them.
episodes.title: Assault

episodes.synopsis: After reuniting with Pascal and Alicia, Shun's determination to return home is stronger than ever.
episodes.title: Determination

episodes.synopsis: While visiting the port city of Ametius to obtain a ship, a deadly killer threatens the adventure.
episodes.title: Girl

episodes.synopsis: After taking to the seas on a battered ship, the Ignauts head for an island to recruit the help of the Zoozians.
episodes.title: Lone Isle

episodes.synopsis: Alicia discovers the truth about her father during a surprise encounter with dragons.
episodes.title: Father and Child

episodes.synopsis: As Delzaine and the Ignauts both close in on Babylon, Pascal attempts to solve the mystery of the decreasing Warp Particles.
episodes.title: Feelings

episodes.synopsis: Upon reaching Babylon, the Ignauts are deceived by more than its size and the traps that await inside.
episodes.title: Depths

episodes.synopsis: The showdown reaches full swing as Babel starts up, bringing an end to an enemy in more than one way.
episodes.title: The Light of Babel

episodes.synopsis: While Pascal and Joseph are busy inspecting Babel, the others look back on how far they've come.
episodes.title: Tracks

episodes.synopsis: With chaos and riots on the rise, the Ignauts make plans to bring order while marching back towards the capital for more research.
episodes.title: Resume

episodes.synopsis: When they attempt to save a crippled village, the Ignauts run into an old enemy and make an unexpected new ally.
episodes.title: Monster

episodes.synopsis: In order to recruit the help of the Gradido and the island Zoozians, the Ignauts must fight back against a naval invasion.
episodes.title: Longing

episodes.synopsis: No sooner is the group welcomed home to the castle than a menace appears in the forest and threatens the capital.
episodes.title: Return

episodes.synopsis: While fields and forests decay, deep under the dungeons of the castle, Shun and Emilio learn more about the past before being swept away.
episodes.title: Prisoner

episodes.synopsis: Taken to the surface, Shun introduces Emilio to his familiar world and a confrontation with Shun's father triggers some of Emilio's forgotten memories.
episodes.title: Surface

episodes.synopsis: After hearing Asanaga's shocking declaration, Shun and Emilio discover secrets of the past, the truth of their families, and a shared bond.
episodes.title: Past

episodes.synopsis: Though troubled by his father's actions, Shun learns about his motivation and the reason they're able to travel between worlds.
episodes.title: Confrontation

episodes.synopsis: Back in Endora, the Ignauts face up against a monsterous Ibelda and learn about the ancient ruins which may be funneling Warp Particles to the surface.
episodes.title: Crisis

episodes.synopsis: While Demetrio and the Ignauts battle Ibelda, Shun, Emilio and Falarion go to Tir Na Nog to destroy the device draining Warp Particles from Endora.
episodes.title: Showdown

episodes.synopsis: The final battle to determine the fate of Endora balances atop the high-reaching spire of Tir Na Nog.
episodes.title: Demise
